scope: Additional public research only for 11 existing private historic offers. No PDE/Git/registry/import/root-state mutation, no final descriptions.

newFindings.claimsSource: Public uploader description, not a transcript or inspected video frames

Description distinguishes six existing paintball settings and a future cemetery proposal; not new lifecycle evidence for the target rides.

newFindings.claimsSource: Public uploader description, not a transcript or inspected video frames
relevantFacts: Primary 2016 tourism report explicitly lists Saut dans le vide among the additions since the previous year, with climbing/ejector/rope courses.
25 m describes climbing wall in this description and conflicts with other measurements; must not be copied as the drop height.

specificDetailPackets.name: Saut dans le vide
specificDetailPackets.readiness: Sufficient specific historical physical facts for parent drafting; strong native image already retained.
observations: Burgundy steel structure and elevated grated platform.
Yellow mesh guardrails around an opening used for departure.
Participant wearing a harness, tethered below a green overhead device.
Fox graphic on yellow panel behind the platform.
Supplier labels the apparatus QUICKjump XL + Ripcord and names Pokeyland.
specificDetailPackets.newDateEvidence: MyLorraine upload dated 19 July 2016 lists the activity among the extension additions since the previous year. This supports a 2016 novelty description, not an exact first operating day.
limits: Do not assert exact drop height: 18 m tourism, 20 m equipment caption, 23 m tower caption and 25 m climbing-wall text are unresolved/distinct measures.
Do not assert present operation, current compliance, opening day or photo capture date.
The photograph shows preparation on the platform, not a participant already falling.
specificDetailPackets.photoImportReadiness: Real native 1000×1500 JPEG, 675727 bytes, no visible watermark; parent duplicate and visual review required.

specificDetailPackets.name: Mini-buggy
specificDetailPackets.readiness: Sufficient specific historical physical facts for parent drafting; current photo research-only because signed.
observations: Single low black seat with an upright back, steering wheel and open tubular body.
Roll bar behind the seat and woven side/foot retention netting.
Four knobby tyres; broad metal footstep on the side.
Red rear/side panel bearing a yellow flame motif.
Separate small quad bikes aligned behind; do not describe their saddle/handlebars as the buggy.
Nominal article caption associates mini-buggies with wooded paths for children.
specificDetailPackets.newDateEvidence: MyLorraine public description uploaded 19 August 2015 independently names mini-buggee among family activities.
limits: Do not infer maker, model, power, fuel, speed, circuit length, age limits or current operation.
Photo is signed Photo: Thierry Hauuy pour Tout-Metz.com; no importing or cropping out signature.

specificDetailPackets.name: Segway
specificDetailPackets.readiness: Sufficient specific historical physical/activity facts for parent drafting; no separate admissible photo.
observations: Riders standing on platforms between two broad side wheels.
Central upright handlebar column; helmets worn in the photographed scene.
Several vehicles follow one another along a gravel route bordered by timber edging/fencing and planting.
2015 reportage explicitly describes longer escorted trips, including behind paintball grounds.
Separate signed 2015 relaxation photograph shows a Segway sign over a wooden gateway, supporting a dedicated historical meeting area.
limits: Le Lorrain file combines two photographs, Segway and tower; not a single scene and not admissible under no-montage rule.
Do not copy the reporter’s personal 2016 duration/distance as fixed route specification.
No make/model beyond name, current thresholds, current operation or exact route.
specificDetailPackets.photoImportReadiness: No acceptable separate native original found; retained montage is research only.

method: Reused earlier sources and inspected whole native images. Additional research targeted primary tourism videos and the park communication supplier rather than repeating blocked archive/social searches. Facts are research observations, not final publication wording. All capture dates and current statuses remain unknown unless explicitly sourced.
